components.title: Components

components.what: Which parts of the model this project uses, and how fully data entities are defined
components.adminOnly: Only a platform administrator can change these.
components.addedByDependency: Also switched on, because a chosen part needs them: {list}
components.blocked: These must be cleared before the change can be made:
components.depthWhat: How much of each data entity this project defines. This decides which warnings the data model shows.
components.depth.KEYS_ONLY: Keys only — primary and foreign keys
components.off: {name} is not used on this project
components.offBody: A platform administrator can switch it on in Settings → Components.
components.added: Added because a chosen part needs it: {list}
components.dfdRule.title: What makes a DFD complete
components.dfdRule.what: What every process of this chart needs before the scope can be frozen. A process missing one of these shows red and blocks the freeze; one that meets them but misses a recommended element shows yellow and does not block.
components.dfdRule.off: This chart's DFD is not used on this project, so its rule does not block a freeze.
components.dfdRule.fallback: No rule is saved for this chart, so the basic rule applies and the freeze is refused until an administrator saves one.
components.dfdRule.element.STARTED.label: Something starts it
components.dfdRule.element.STARTED.help: A trigger, a data input, or an inbound outside party. Always required.
components.dfdRule.element.DATA_IN.label: Data in
components.dfdRule.element.DATA_IN.help: At least one data entity the process reads.
components.dfdRule.element.DATA_OUT.help: At least one data entity the process writes.
components.dfdRule.element.EXTERNAL.labe: An outside party on each diagram
components.dfdRule.element.EXTERNAL.help: Each data flow diagram shows at least one outside party. Checked per diagram, not per process.
components.dfdRule.element.ORDER.label: Joined to the flow
components.dfdRule.element.ORDER.help: The process reads data another writes, or writes data another reads. Needs data in and data out, because the order comes from the data.
components.dfdRule.counts: Under this rule: {ready} ready, {partly} partly, {not} not ready.
components.dfdRule.wouldBlock: The next freeze would be refused for {n} processes and {d} diagrams until they are completed.
components.dfdRule.blocksNone: Nothing in this chart would block the next freeze.
